## Themed tabs

- A session's theme override now colors its tab too, not just its terminal, so a production host stands out in the tab strip.
- New Crimson theme, a deep wine red made for that use. Its tabs stay clearly red even when not selected.
- The focused pane is outlined like a folder tab, from the selected tab down around the pane, instead of coloring the whole gutter beside it.
- A session themed differently from the app is always outlined, even without a split.

## Terminal

- The terminal engine is updated to libghostty-vt 1.4. It parses output faster (up to several times faster for plain text and long escape sequences), reflows faster on resize, and includes crash and security fixes.
- Scrollback that has sat idle is compressed in the background. Long-running tabs use much less memory: 20,000 lines of colored log output dropped from about 21 MB to under 1 MB.
- Programs can copy to the Windows clipboard with the Kitty clipboard protocol. Only the plain text is copied, and remote programs still can't read your clipboard.
- Keyboard and mouse reporting follow more of the modes programs set, which fixes Backspace under DECBKM, modifyOtherKeys, UTF-8 mouse reporting and Alt with non-ASCII keys.
- Programs that check for Kitty graphics or the Glyph Protocol are told they aren't supported, so they fall back instead of sending images or glyphs that resesh doesn't draw.

Choose the x64 download for Intel or AMD PCs. Choose ARM64 only for Windows on ARM devices.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/bpbp-boop/resesh/compare/v0.21.0...v0.22.0)
